email.subject: A couple quick fixes for Fast Lane Pros' site
email.body:
Hi Chloe,

I took a look at Fast Lane Pros' website. Two things are likely costing you calls: there's no click-to-call button, so mobile visitors have to copy and dial your number manually, and your hours aren't listed anywhere, so people unsure if you're open just call a competitor instead.

I also noticed no customer reviews on the site and a footer with outdated info.

I fix these kinds of issues for a flat fee. Happy to do a free 10-minute walkthrough showing exactly what I'd change, no obligation. Would Thursday or Friday work?

Alex
